How to Create a new template

The structure of the themes are as shown below

-nameoftheme
    -admin
        -admin.htm
        -config.htm
        -email.htm
        -group.htm
        -help.htm
        -link.htm
        -logs.htm
        -page.htm
        -plugins.htm
        -user.htm
        -user_add.htm
    -plugins
        -plugins.htm
-error.htm
-footer.htm
-header.htm
-maintain.htm
-page.htm
-profile.htm
-register.htm


These are the needed files you can set the rest of the structure up how ever
you want to.
